name: Final Frame
source:
Inspired by Danganronpa and Ace Attorney series, Final Frame is a murder mystery Visual Novel set in modern Japan.

An internet urban legend known as "Black Swan" has circulated in social media.
The players are given a series of challenges to complete within thirteen days - each day with increasing difficulty, with the final day requiring the player to perform the most difficult task of them all - taking their very own life.

One of the victims of "Black Swan" is said to be from Hitaki Academy, the very school Kurogashi Takaya has recently transferred to. The seemingly ordinary boy with an equally normal hobby of taking photos of his surroundings, save for one difference - Takaya can see his own death reflected in the photos he has taken.

Will Takaya be able to escape his incoming death? Follow his story, take photographs and use them to solve murder cases!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294260/Final_Frame/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Final Frame》的灵感源自《弹丸论破》和《逆转裁判》系列，是一部以现代日本为背景的谋杀悬疑视觉小说。

一个被称为“黑天鹅”的网络都市传说在社交媒体上流传。
玩家需要在十三天内完成一系列挑战——每一天的难度都在增加，最后一天要求玩家完成其中最困难的任务——结束自己的生命。

据说“黑天鹅”的受害者之一来自日泷学园，黑河高也最近转学到了这所学校。这个看似普通的男孩有着给周围环境拍照的同样正常的爱好，除了一处不同之外——高谷可以在他拍摄的照片中看到自己的死亡。

高也能否逃脱即将到来的死亡呢？跟随他的故事，拍照并用它们来侦破谋杀案！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294260/Final_Frame/]Steam[/url]]
